title: Three.js underwater visual effect
author: K Erica 🌸 buidl mode: on
verification: Fetched from X via twitter-cli from global-search; original author and post URL preserved.
note: Original post did not expose a complete repeatable prompt. Treat this as a real showcase post, not a verified tutorial.
originalText:
這張圖上半部分是（還能）用 Fable 5（的時候）做的 three.js 躍入海底的視覺效果，下半部分是三年前我在加勒比一帶潛入海中之後、對著海面拍攝的實際視覺效果。

似乎還是現實世界中，透過這個視角去看海面，更美一點~ 等卷完我所有想做的東西，打算去美洲再待一陣子當成休息~ 如果 Strategy 能早點認輸違約，這一天也將更早到來~ GN~
summary: Compares a Fable 5-built three.js underwater-surface visual effect with the author's real underwater photo reference from the Caribbean.
